name: @pathpulse/edge-engine
//: Phase 16 — the edge-deployable software engine. The SAME nav-core that runs in the phone, running outside it: an external IMU stream in, NavigationState out, at rates a handset cannot reach. This is a compulsory deliverable of SIH26168 ('a working mobile application AND an Edge deployable software engine'), and it exists as a port rather than a rewrite only because nav-core never took a browser dependency.
